description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableMessagePath' implementing 'MessagePath', representing a message path using JSON pointers with methods to interpret and manipulate message paths in a messaging protocol.

classes.name: ImmutableMessagePath
classes.description: Immutable implementation of MessagePath, encapsulating a JsonPointer and providing methods to interpret and manipulate message paths.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMessagePath instance from a JsonPointer after null check.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Retrieves the feature ID from the JSON pointer if present.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Determines the message direction from the JSON pointer.

methods.name: addLeaf
methods.description: Adds a leaf key to the JSON pointer.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends another JSON pointer to this one.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of levels in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON pointer is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON key at a specific level.

methods.name: cutLeaf
methods.description: Removes the leaf from the JSON pointer.

methods.name: nextLevel
methods.description: Advances to the next level in the JSON pointer.

methods.name: getSubPointer
methods.description: Gets a sub-pointer at a specific level.

methods.name: getPrefixPointer
methods.description: Gets a prefix pointer up to a specific level.

methods.name: toFieldSelector
methods.description: Converts the JSON pointer to a JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the JSON pointer.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specific index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the JSON pointer.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JSON keys.
